_README: Per-class biochemistry crosswalk for §31 of the clean-sheet lead page. Each row: established biochemistry (author-year; DOI to VERIFY against the project library) -> the kind of locus evidence that maps to it -> the allowed (claim-safe) conclusion. Class keys are matched by the generator from CCTT triggers + dominant convergence compound + antiSMASH products. Cite at family-logic level; comparators are similarity, not identity.
PTM_HSAF: A single hybrid PKS-NRPS loads an ornithine unit and builds the polyene acyl chain; the terminal TE releases the tetramic-acid macrolactam (HSAF, Lysobacter; Yu/Zaleta-Rivera/Du, AAC 2007; Lou et al., JACS 2011).
hybrid PKS-NRPS core with an Orn-predicted A-domain + TE
The ikarugamycin IkaABC set is the minimal 3-gene PTM system: hybrid PKS-NRPS + two oxidoreductases performing oxidative C-C cyclization (Zhang/Tang-lab ikarugamycin studies).
tandem FAD Amino_oxidase genes flanking the core
polycyclic-ring oxidative-cyclization capacity; ring topology unknown
A sterol-desaturase/FA-hydroxylase tailors HSAF ring oxidation, distinguishing HSAF-type from des-oxy congeners.
FA_hydroxylase adjacent to the oxidoreductase pair
ring-oxidation tailoring capacity; oxidation state unproven
GPA_glycopeptide: Glycopeptide (vancomycin/teicoplanin/balhimycin) aglycone assembly requires crosslinking cytochrome-P450 (OxyA/B/C) oxidative phenol couplings on an NRPS heptapeptide (Suessmuth/Robinson reviews).
>=3 clustered crosslinking Oxy-P450 on an NRPS heptapeptide
crosslinked-GPA aglycone capacity; exact residues unresolved
Non-proteinogenic residues Dpg (DpgA-D) and Hpg (HmaS/Hmo) are hallmark GPA building blocks.
VanHAX-type D-Ala-D-Lac remodeling confers producer self-resistance in GPA clusters.
target-based self-resistance prior (not a measured phenotype)
enediyne: Enediyne cores are built by an iterative PKSE (ene_KS) warhead synthase plus a dedicated tailoring/self-resistance cassette (Shen-lab calicheamicin/C-1027 studies).
An apoprotein and self-sacrificing resistance protein co-occur with enediyne warheads.
self-protection prior consistent with a cytotoxic warhead
phosphonate: Phosphonate C-P bonds are committed by PEP mutase (PepM), the diagnostic first step, followed by phosphonopyruvate decarboxylase (fosfomycin/dehydrophos/rhizocticin; Metcalf/van der Donk studies).
C-P-bond phosphonate warhead capacity; product unresolved
Phosphonopeptides (rhizocticin/plumbemycin) target threonine synthase/AHAS (antifungal); phosphono-antibiotics (fosfomycin) target MurA.
dual antibacterial/antifungal capacity prior; screen both panels
PBD_pyrrolobenzodiazepine: Pyrrolobenzodiazepines (tomaymycin/anthramycin/sibiromycin) are NRPS-derived; an anthranilate-processing + dioxygenase/oxidase tailoring set builds the PBD scaffold; tomA is essential (Thomas/Hurley studies).
PBD-scaffold-class capacity (rare class); DNA minor-groove-alkylator family prior
lanthipeptide: Class I lanthipeptides are matured by LanB (dehydratase) + LanC (cyclase) on a ribosomal LanA precursor; class II by a bifunctional LanM (Van der Donk lanthipeptide studies).
LanB+LanC (or LanM) with an in-window precursor CDS
lanthipeptide RiPP maturation capacity; precursor/product unresolved
thioamitide_thioamide: Thioamitides (thioviridamide-like) install thioamide bonds via a YcaO + TfuA pair on a ribosomal precursor (Mitchell/Truman thioamide studies).
siderophore: Hydroxamate/catecholate siderophores (desferrioxamine/coelichelin/mirubactin) are built by NIS synthetases (IucA/IucC) or NRPS with iron-chelating residues (Challis siderophore studies).
IucA/IucC (NIS) or NRPS with chelator residues
iron-chelation siderophore capacity; exact chelator unresolved
aminoglycoside: 2-deoxystreptamine aminoglycosides commit via 2-deoxy-scyllo-inosose synthase (DOIS/BtrC); tailoring aminotransferases/dehydratases follow (Spencer/Llewellyn studies).
modular_PKS_macrolide: Modular type-I PKS assembles polyketides by successive KS-AT-(DH-ER-KR)-ACP modules; a macrolactonizing TE releases macrolides (Cane/Khosla PKS studies).
modular polyketide backbone capacity; module count a lower bound if edge-truncated
NRPS_generic: Modular NRPS activates and condenses amino acids via C-A-PCP modules; A-domain Stachelhaus codes predict substrate at similarity level only (Marahiel/Gulick NRPS studies; Miller & Gulick 2016).
C-A-PCP module set with A-domain substrate predictions
nonribosomal peptide backbone capacity; substrate calls are predictions, not biochemistry
terpene: Terpene skeletons form via a class-I/II terpene cyclase acting on prenyl-diphosphate precursors; many actinomycete terpene loci are housekeeping (hopene/geosmin) (Dickschat terpene studies).
terpenoid capacity; default Inventory unless a non-housekeeping tailoring cassette is present
GENERIC: antiSMASH KnownClusterBlast/MIBiG similarity indicates pathway-family relatedness and does NOT establish production of the named compound; manual verification is required (antiSMASH 7, Blin et al., NAR 2023, DOI:10.1093/nar/gkad344).
class/pathway-family capacity only; not compound identity
